scientific_scope_status: Full35-coefficient homogeneous rank-one-convex planar quartic; fixed unit rank-one R0 with F(R0)>0, simple acoustic null A0, rank-three PSD Finsler remainder with kernel R0. Centered determinant-balanced finite-fourth-moment laws relatively close to R0 in both L2/L4. All affine backgrounds, no amplitude cap or nonzero moment floor. Tangent rank-two remainder and general large-transverse fields excluded.
